template.name: Interface Traffic Agent 32-bit counters
template.comments:
{}Template to collect network traffic via NetXMS agent. For systems with 32-bit traffic counters.
Set custom attribute `Template.InterfaceTraffic` to `Yes` on a node to get this template applied automatically. DCIs are added for Ethernet and point-to-point interfaces with expected state `UP`. To skip an interface, set `Template.InterfaceTraffic` to `No` on that interface or list its name in the node's `Template.InterfaceTraffic.Exclude` custom attribute (comma-separated).
To collect traffic only on selected interfaces, set `Template.InterfaceTraffic.Marked` to `Yes` on the node instead, and set `Template.InterfaceTraffic` to `Yes` on each interface to collect from. In this mode interface type and expected state are not checked. An inheritable `Template.InterfaceTraffic` attribute on the node marks all its interfaces.
To apply the template to multiple nodes at once, set the custom attribute on a container and enable inheritance on it.
